statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack (Z86.73)
There is concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia contributing to these symptoms
The service is to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The diagnosis I49.9 reflects the underlying cardiac condition supporting the need for this service
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
